compiler_only_output.reason: mwccarm emits all three destructor variants from the single out-of-line `daObjKanban_c::~daObjKanban_c()` this TU defines, so the base-object variant comes out beside the licensed D1/D0 pair. The cartridge has no D2 for this class: ov085 runs D1 at 0x0212edac into D0 at 0x0212edf8, and 0x0212edf8 + 0x60 lands exactly on CleanupResources at 0x0212ee58, so the licensed run leaves no gap a third variant could occupy, and no symbols.txt in the tree names one. Homeless, and no surviving relocation reaches it.

`~dBgActor_c()` is defined inline in the class body at include/dBgActor_c.h:43, so it has vague linkage, and this TU destroys a dBgActor_c base subobject in two places -- `daObjKanban_c::~daObjKanban_c()` and the `new daObjKanban_c()` in daObjKanban_c_classInit -- which makes mwccarm emit the base's out-of-line base-object copy here as well as inlining it. The cartridge carries only dBgActor_c's complete and deleting variants, D1 at ov002:0x020ee42c and D0 at ov002:0x020ee464, and no D2 anywhere, so this 0x38-byte body has no configured home.

This TU declares five Vector3 locals: `mine`, `pos` and `tpos` at the top of Behavior, `opos` in Behavior's no-target branch, and `v` in InitResources, which copies data_ov085_0212f29c out before handing it to dCcAcPos_c::Init. Each is a class-type automatic, so mwccarm re-emits Vector3's vague-linkage complete destructor alongside this TU's own text. The cartridge keeps exactly one copy, the four-byte `bx lr` (1e ff 2f e1) at arm9:0x020072c0, and the enrolled complete entry src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp already owns those bytes; rombuild byte-compares this object's body against the cartridge and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.

This TU owns daObjKanban_c's key function -- ~daObjKanban_c is the first virtual the class declares and its body is out of line here -- so mwcc emits the complete 0x88-byte class vtable storage with its two-word ABI preamble. The cartridge's public address point is ov085:0x02130400, eight bytes above the start of storage at 0x021303f8 (where the offset-to-top word reads 0 and the typeinfo word reads 0x021303c0) and outside this text-only entry's licensed 0x0212edac..0x0212f27c range, so dsd supplies that ROM data independently. Slot 0 at the address point reads 0x0212f1b0, this TU's own InitResources. romdata_check applies the measured eight-byte address-point bias and proves every emitted slot and relocation against the cartridge before production isolation discards the copy.
